mission: Turn raw evidence into reusable visual intent: what each color, asset, motion, frame, or layout pattern means and where it should or should not be used.
tasks: translate evidence into composition, color-role, type, boundary, asset, density and motion patterns
declare suitableFor, notFor and allowed transformations
requirements: every pattern has evidenceRefs and normalized sourceRegion
every composition pattern freezes a compositionContract containing source asset identity/variant and required structural layers before implementation
every color role declares allowedRoles and forbiddenRoles
facts, interpretations and recommendations use separate fields
composition and information density are explicit
mustNot: lower learn-brand fidelity for host convenience
promote a third-party summary directly to a rule
passCriteria: every mustPreserve item maps to a pattern
composition mustPreserve mappings freeze source asset identity/variant and at least two independently observable required layers
every core pattern has evidence, usage and notFor
receiptRequirements: agentExecutionId from a real spawned subagent
input and output file sha256 values
on fail, failureOwnerRole identifies brandResearcher, designTranslator, or demoImplementationAgent
